![Rubber Ducky](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KellyKP/WoW-Rubber-Ducky/main/docs/logo.png)

# Rubber Ducky

*Your little fishing buddy* for **World of Warcraft: Forever**.

Rubber Ducky makes fishing easier on the ears and eyes. It hushes the world so the splash stands out, marks your bobber, eases the camera toward the water, and lets one button cast and reel in. Your catch lands straight in your bags with a splash banner. It's made for controller play, and it works just as well with mouse and keyboard.

## Features

- **Sound focus.** While your line is out, sound effects go up and music, ambience and dialog fade to a low mumble. It fades back as soon as you catch something or miss.
- **Bobber marker.** A rubber duck, or any of 37 bobber icons, floats above your bobber, with sparkles around it. Each one has a little story in the picker.
- **Fishing camera.** The camera eases in toward the water while you fish and back out when you're done.
- **One-button fishing.** With a pole equipped, one button casts and reels in. You can use Interact, or the left or right trigger on a controller. The button goes back to normal when you take the pole off or combat starts.
- **Auto loot.** Your catch goes straight to your bags, whichever button reeled it in. It doesn't change the game's own auto-loot setting.
- **Catch splash.** A banner slams onto the screen with what you caught, and each item's rarity colours its line. Misses get a splash too: "Missed!" when you reel in empty, and "Zzz..." when the cast runs out.
- **Fishing log.** Everything you caught this session on a parchment board: how many, what it was, and a cute note, both written in the catch's rarity colour. It opens when you equip a fishing pole and closes when you put it away, can be dragged anywhere, and scrolls when you've caught more than seven kinds of thing. An optional log button brings it up any time; right-click it to lock it in place.
- **Fishing journal.** A leather-bound book of everything you've ever caught, one for each character. Catches is every fish you've caught, with a little map of where each one bit, your own notes and a word from Ducky; Whosits & Whatsits holds everything else that comes up on the line; Waters lists every spot you've fished and what bites there; Records keeps your totals, personal bests, streaks, firsts and collection progress.
- **Ducky's Challenges.** Dozens of little goals, from finding all three Rumsey Rums to catching something after midnight, some hidden until you stumble on them.
- **Shiny Fishbones.** Now and then one comes up with your catch, and every challenge pays some. They turn up more often by a Fishing Rack or Fishing Hut, in a Lucky Fishing Hat, at the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, or with Fellow Ducky Anglers fishing in your zone.
- **Mrrl's Doohicky Emporium.** Trade your Fishbones with Mrrl for bobbers, quarterboards, charms and mottos. Give him a poke and he'll chat.
- **Fishing flair.** While your pole is out, your quarterboard hangs over your head with your name and motto, your bobber and charm swinging from it, for Fellow Ducky Anglers to see. Yours hangs off the top of the fishing log.
- **Pole swap.** Drag the Pole swap icon onto any action bar or crossbar slot. One press puts your fishing pole on, and the next puts back the weapon you had before, each with its own splash and sound. It warns you if either one is broken.
- **Share settings.** Copy your settings as text to share your setup, or paste a friend's. It's on the overview page.

## Install

1. Download the latest release.
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`, so that you have `AddOns/RubberDucky/RubberDucky.toc`.
3. Restart the game, or type `/reload`.

The first time you log in, a welcome screen helps you set things up. After that, type `/ducky` to open the settings. They're also under **Options > AddOns > Rubber Ducky**.

## Commands

You can also click **Rubber Ducky** in the minimap's AddOns list for a menu with the fishing log, the journal, Ducky's Challenges, Mrrl's shop and settings.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/ducky` | Open the settings |
| `/ducky icons` | Pick your bobber icon |
| `/ducky swap` | Swap between your fishing pole and your weapon, out of combat (what the Ducky Pole macro runs) |
| `/ducky swap 1`, `/ducky swap 2` | Put on your pole (1) or your weapon (2). `pole` and `weapon` work too |
| `/ducky log` | Open or close the fishing log |
| `/ducky journal` | Open or close the fishing journal |
| `/ducky challenges` | Open or close Ducky's Challenges |
| `/ducky shop` | Visit Mrrl's Doohicky Emporium |
| `/ducky test` | Preview the sparkle and bobber icon |
| `/ducky focus`, `sparkle`, `marker`, `camera`, `onekey` | Turn a feature on or off |
| `/ducky welcome` | Show the welcome screen again |
| `/ducky restore` | Put your sound and camera back right now |
| `/ducky help` | List the commands |

## Good to know

- **Bobber marker range.** Forever only soft-targets the bobber within about 10 yards. The marker and sparkles attach through that, so they don't show on longer casts. Reeling in with one button has the same limit.
- **No bite alert.** Forever doesn't tell addons when a fish bites, so Rubber Ducky can't alert you to one. Sound focus makes the splash as easy to hear as possible instead.
- **Other sound addons.** Another addon that changes music or ambience volume while you fish will fight with sound focus. Turn the sound option off in one of them.
- **Experimental camera notice.** The first time the camera eases in, the game may show a notice about experimental camera settings.

## Reporting a bug

The quickest help: turn on **Include debug info when copying settings** on the Developer page, then press **Copy my settings** on the overview page and paste the text into your issue. It lists your settings, game details and other addons.

For more detail, open the **Developer** page in the settings and switch on debug mode. A small console window appears. Do whatever causes the problem, then press **Copy** in the console and paste the text into your issue. For fishing problems, also tick **Event recorder** under Developer and fish once. Then send its log, which opens with **Show log** under Developer or `/ducky events`.

## Credits

The camera and one-button approaches follow [Improved Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/improved-forever) (MIT), which showed what Forever allows.

The handwriting in the fishing log and on the signs is [Patrick Hand](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Patrick+Hand) by Patrick Wagesreiter, and Mrrl's lettering is [Lilita One](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Lilita+One) by Juan Montoreano, both under the SIL Open Font License (`Media/Fonts/OFL.txt`).

Changelog
0.24.0
New
Fishing journal: a leather-bound book of everything you've ever caught, one for each character. Open it from Rubber Ducky's line in the minimap's AddOns list, an optional journal button you can drag anywhere, or a "Ducky Journal" macro for your action bars. /ducky journal does the same.
Catches: every fish you've caught and the ones still to find, sorted by zone, rarity, name, most caught or most recent, with a note of your own for every catch, a little map of where it bit, and a word from Ducky.
Whosits & Whatsits: the crates, trunks, bottles, boots and skulls that come up on your line instead of a fish, with the same sorting as Catches and a filter for just treasure or just junk.
Waters: every spot you've fished, what bites there, and the zones you've yet to discover, in the order you'd travel them.
Records: your totals, personal bests (biggest haul, rarest catch, busiest and luckiest spots, longest session), streaks, dated firsts and how close each collection is to complete.
The first time you open a new catch, its page is written in: the name letter by letter, then each line, then its rarity badge is stamped down.
Find everything on Catches or Whosits & Whatsits and the page gets stamped COMPLETE!
Ducky's Challenges: dozens of little goals, from finding all three Rumsey Rums to catching something after midnight, some hidden until you stumble on them. Finish one and a banner pops at the top of the screen. Open them from Records, Rubber Ducky's menu or /ducky challenges. Anything you'd already done before this update counts straight away.
Works with a controller: the D-pad browses, the shoulder buttons flip bookmarks, the View button hops between the left and right pages, Y opens Ducky's Challenges, and a bar under the book shows the rest when the Gamepad UI is on.
First-ever catches get a "New!" on the catch splash and in the fishing log, with a little sparkle.
The fishing log writes in each new catch: its icon is stamped onto the page, then the words appear left to right with a quill's scratch.
Rubber Ducky has its own settings window, opened from its menu, /ducky, or the feature list on the overview page, and it goes straight to the page you want. It's still listed in the game's own AddOns settings too. It works with a controller too, as do the Welcome screen and Ducky's Challenges: the D-pad moves between settings, A picks, the shoulder buttons turn pages, and the same controls bar as the journal shows the rest.
A fresh look for every Rubber Ducky window: wood, gold and parchment, from settings and the Welcome screen to the bobber picker, What's new and Share settings. The bobber picker works with a controller too.
Six new bobbers: Froggy, Murloc, Otter, Pipi, Thrall and Jaina.
Twelve brand-new bobbers, from a Golden Duck to a Night Owl, and every bobber now has a little story in the picker.
Shiny Fishbones: now and then one comes up with your catch (always with epics and treasure), and every one of Ducky's Challenges pays some. They turn up more often by a Fishing Rack or Fishing Hut, in a Lucky Fishing Hat, at the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, or while Fellow Ducky Anglers are fishing in your zone; a little framed icon in the fishing log's corner shows when you're in luck. Challenges you'd already finished pay up the first time you log in. They show on the catch splash, in chat with the rest of your loot, in the fishing log and on Records.
Fishing flair: while your pole is out, your quarterboard hangs over your head with your name and motto on it, your bobber and charm swinging from its rivets and your guild just underneath, for your Fellow Ducky Anglers to see. Theirs show over theirs. Your own hangs off the top of the fishing log, since the game shows no name over your own head. Boards only show if you show player names, and nameplates are only touched while a Fellow Ducky Angler is fishing in your zone. Change it all on the new Fishing flair settings page.
Mrrl's Doohicky Emporium: trade your Fishbones with Mrrl for bobbers, 120 quarterboards, charms and mottos. Visit from Rubber Ducky's menu, the bobber picker, the Fishing journal settings page or /ducky shop. Give Mrrl a poke and he'll chat. It works with a controller too. The big prizes, like the Golden Duck, are still earned from Ducky's Challenges, and a bobber you're already using stays yours.
Changed
The fishing log has a new look: a hand-lettered title on the top plank, seven rows, and cattails tucked over the bottom one. When it's more than fits, scroll with the mouse wheel or the rope down its side instead of turning pages.
Smaller download: the big pictures are packed the game's own way, at a third of the size, with no difference you can see.
Pole swap gives you a heads up when the pole or weapon you're swapping to is broken, so you know to get it repaired.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KellyKP/WoW-Rubber-Ducky/compare/v0.23.0...v0.24.0

## 0.23.0

### New

- Fishing log: everything you caught this session on a parchment board, each with a cute note written in its rarity colour. It opens when you equip a fishing pole and goes away when you take it off. Turn it off, resize it or stop it opening by itself on the new Fishing log settings page.
- Open the log yourself, for when it doesn't open by itself: an optional log button you can drag anywhere (right-click to lock it in place), or a "Ducky Log" macro for your action bars, both on the Fishing log settings page. `/ducky log` does the same.
- Rubber Ducky has its own line in the minimap's AddOns list: click it for a little menu with the fishing log and settings.
- One-button fishing settings show what each button is bound to, like Interact [F] or Interact [Not Bound], with steps for binding it when it isn't.
- The bobber icon can sit Low, Medium or High above your bobber.
- After an update, the hello in chat lets you know, and points you to What's new.
- Friendlier settings: Pole swap and Your catch have their own pages, and Copy and Paste settings sit at the top of the overview. Each page has a reset button to put its settings back, and on the Fishing log page, its positions too.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KellyKP/WoW-Rubber-Ducky/compare/v0.22.0...v0.23.0
